sample_unit: AI tools (chatbots and social-media assistants), each queried with 4 standardized questions

links.outcome: Readability grade level of AI outputs on peptide questions versus patient-material target
links.effect: All 11 tools produced outputs at the college level (mean grade 13.9), above the sixth-to-eighth-grade target for patient materials; no correlation between quality and readability.
links.quote: All 11 tools produced outputs at the college level (mean grade: 13.9), above the sixth-to-eighth-grade target for patient materials, with no correlation between quality and readability.

links.outcome: Reading level of AI-generated patient information versus appropriate reading level
links.effect: Mean grade level 13.9 across all 11 tools, above the sixth-to-eighth-grade target for patient materials.
links.quote: All 11 tools produced outputs at the college level (mean grade: 13.9), above the sixth-to-eighth-grade target for patient materials, with no correlation between quality and readability.

links.outcome: Misinformation in generative AI outputs about unregulated peptides
links.effect: Instagram (Meta AI) spread misinformation, claiming BPC-157 accelerates recovery and endorsing post-surgical use; X and Facebook accurate, TikTok mixed.
links.quote: Among social-media assistants, X and Facebook were accurate, TikTok was mixed, and Instagram (Meta AI) spread misinformation, claiming BPC-157 accelerates recovery and endorsing post-surgical use.

links.outcome: Accuracy, completeness quality (QAMAI) of dedicated AI tools' outputs against evidence
links.effect: Mean QAMAI 21.6/30 (range 17.8 to 25.3); accuracy highest (4.0/5), completeness lowest (3.3/5).
links.quote: Among dedicated tools, pooled QAMAI domain scores were highest for accuracy (4.0/5) and lowest for completeness (3.3/5).

unlisted_practices: Medical societies partnering with AI developers to standardize evidence-anchored responses on unregulated products

screen.reason: Empirical content analysis evaluating the accuracy, completeness, and readability of outputs from 11 LLMs and social media AI assistants on unregulated peptides, but does not test an organizational deployment practice or guardrail intervention.
